Class Tribe

java.lang.Object
model.player.Tribe
public class Tribe extends Object
Represents a player's tribe, acting as the in-game inventory of every CharacterCard and BuildingCard acquired during the match.

Character cards are partitioned by type into dedicated collections (artists, builders, gatherers, hunters, shamans) for fast type-specific access; inventors are further grouped by InventionIcon to support the scoring rule that rewards icon diversity. Building cards are kept in a single list, while their effects are mirrored into three separate registries — OnAcquireBuildingEffect, OnEventBuildingEffect and EndGameBuildingEffect — populated through the registerSelf callbacks of each effect at acquisition time.

The class also centralises all card-counting and end-game scoring formulas, exposing them as query methods so that Player and the end-of-game phase handler can compute prestige contributions without inspecting the underlying collections directly.

All collection getters return unmodifiable views to preserve encapsulation: mutations must go through the dedicated add* and register* methods.

    • countCompleteSets

      public int countCompleteSets()
      Counts the number of complete sets of character types. A complete set contains one card of each character type (artist, builder, gatherer, hunter, inventor, shaman). Returns the minimum count across all types, representing the maximum number of complete sets that can be formed.
      Returns:
      the number of complete character sets
